about: Ready-made neighbours and their items to try the site with: npm run seed. The sign-up and sign-in pages offer them in one click when MARKET_DEMO=1. An item's photo is one of db/items. A conversation is about an item, between its seller and a buyer: its messages [who, what, minutes ago], and an offer of the buyer's waiting for an answer.

items.title: Wooden turntable, works perfectly
items.about: Belt drive, walnut plinth, new needle fitted last month. Comes with its dust cover. I can show it playing on a call.

items.title: 35mm film camera with a 50mm lens
items.about: Fully manual, light meter works, shutter tested at every speed. A good one to learn film on.

items.title: Mid-century armchair, reupholstered
items.about: Solid walnut arms, new mustard wool. Very comfortable, and heavier than it looks.

items.title: Road bike, 54 cm frame
items.about: Sixteen gears, new tyres and brake pads this spring. Fits riders from about 170 to 180 cm.

items.title: Monstera, 1.2 m tall, with its pot
items.about: Healthy and growing fast, which is the problem. The terracotta pot comes with it.

items.title: Four handmade speckled mugs
items.about: Stoneware, dishwasher safe, each a little different.

items.title: Leather hiking boots, size 43
items.about: Worn on two short walks, then they turned out half a size too small.

items.title: Brass desk lamp with a green shade
items.about: The classic banker's lamp. Takes a standard bulb, which is included.
